schedule.description: Game recap — Cubs 5-2, Boyd 9-5, Busch & Swanson HRs
Wild Card: Cubs 86-69 WC1 by tiebreaker, Phillies 1 back
October stakes: WC1 = Wrigley hosting, 7 games to go
Series finale preview: Peterson vs Lowder, 12:40 PM CT

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
9-5. That's Boyd's record now.

Boyd ended a 6-start winless streak with 5 strong innings as the Cubs won Game 2 in Cincy 5-2.

Busch with the tiebreaker in the 6th. Swanson's first homer since Aug. 12 sealed it in the 9th.

Win today, take the series.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Wild Card Update — Cubs Hold WC1 at 86-69

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
86-69. Cubs hold WC1.

Saturday's win in Cincy + a Phillies loss to the Mets puts Chicago one up on Philadelphia. Tied with San Diego at 86-69, but the Cubs own the tiebreaker: 5-1 head-to-head vs. the Padres.

Seven games left. Hold the line.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
44 home runs. 37 stolen bases.

Pete Crow-Armstrong needs 3 more steals in 7 games to become the first Cub EVER with a 40-40 season — and just the 7th player in MLB history to pull it off.

The clock is ticking.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

stories.title: October Stakes — WC1 Means Hosting at Wrigley

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
7 games. 86-69. WC1 by tiebreaker.

The Cubs hold the No. 1 Wild Card spot — tied with San Diego but owning a 5-1 head-to-head advantage. No. 1 seed means Wrigley hosts in October.

Brewers have the Central. This is Chicago's race to win.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: Series Finale Preview — Peterson vs Lowder, 12:40 PM CT

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
1-1 in this series. WC1 on the line.

David Peterson (7-8, 5.28 ERA) takes the hill for Chicago today at 12:40 PM CT vs. Rhett Lowder and the Reds. Win this one and the Cubs take the series 2-1.

Great American Ball Park. Let's go get it.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW
